text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is recommending designation of an accessible loading zone on the west side of Russett Avenue. The loading zone will provide curb-side access for Wheel-Trans vehicles picking up or dropping off patrons. The loading zone is required from 8:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. Outside these hours, the area would maintain its current designation as an accessible parking space.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible loading zone on the west side of Russett Avenue, between a point 47 metres south of Wallace Avenue and a point 5.5 metres further south, in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. 2. Amended the existing accessible parking space in effect at all times on the west side of Russett Avenue, between a point 47 metres south of Wallace Avenue and a point 5.5 metres further south, to be in effect from 7:00 p.m. of one day to 8:00 a.m. of the next following day, Monday to Friday, and at all times, Saturday and Sunday.
